grades.reason: Describes the xv6 disk block buffer cache. It has nothing to do with instruction cache synchronization after code modification.

grades.quote: The `CACOP` instruction is mainly used for Cache initialization and cache-consistency maintenance.
grades.reason: Describes the LoongArch CACOP cache-maintenance instruction, which can invalidate instruction-cache lines. This is one possible building block for making modified code visible to fetch. It never mentions modified code, self-modifying code, or the fetch synchronization sequence, so it only partly addresses the query.

Covers the RISC-V CMO CBO.INVAL, CBO.CLEAN, CBO.FLUSH and CBO.ZERO permission and exception behavior. It says nothing about instruction-cache or instruction-fetch synchronization after code modification, such as FENCE.I.
Concerns synchronizing address-translation caches after PTE updates (SFENCE.VMA). It does not cover instruction-cache synchronization after modifying code.
